name: Austria
contextBlurb: Austria follows MiCA. Stablecoin issuance and use are legal with restrictions: EMT and ART issuers need the relevant EU authorisation, compliant reserves, redemption rights, disclosures and AML controls. MiCA passporting applies across the EU once authorised.

stablecoinMeta.summaryEn: Austria follows MiCA. Stablecoin issuance and use are legal with restrictions: EMT and ART issuers need the relevant EU authorisation, compliant reserves, redemption rights, disclosures and AML controls. MiCA passporting applies across the EU once authorised.
stablecoinMeta.classificationNote: Single-fiat stablecoins are generally e-money tokens under MiCA; basket-backed stablecoins are asset-referenced tokens.

regulators.name: Austrian Financial Market Authority
regulators.role: National competent authority for MiCA authorisations and supervision in Austria.
